ⓘ About output distance — Typical/event composite + missing penalty

The primary score blends typical-over-time disagreement with event disagreement. The typical weight is 75%; the event weight is 25%.

typical distance = min(mean(|A − B|) / max(|A|, |B|), 1) event distance = min(RMSE(A − B) / max(RMS(A), RMS(B)), 1) series distance = missing fraction + (1 − missing fraction) × (typical weight × typical distance + event weight × event distance)

One-sided timestamps within the shared timeline, one-sided null or invalid values, and semantic series absent from one engine count as missing. Paired null values are neutral. Trailing-only timestamps are reported as timeline coverage and do not affect value distance. Displayed component scores include this missing-value penalty.

The overall output distance is the equal-weight arithmetic mean of all semantic-series distances. Scores at or below 1% are green, scores at or below 10% are yellow, and larger scores are red.

Report-table comparisons use a separate cell-weighted relative-distance metric.
